title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature will provide detailed logging of incoming requests, including errors, to aid in debugging and performance optimization. It will also include error handling to ensure logging does not disrupt the application. This will improve the overall stability and maintainability of the framework
testCases: Test logging of requests with errors
acceptance: Logging should be enabled by default, with optional configuration for log level and output. Error handling should prevent logging from crashing the application
reason: Improved logging and error handling will increase the framework's reliability and usability in production environments
